'''Feno Gamoc''' was a [[Rybet/Legends|Rybet]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as a senior [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] aboard the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']]. At the conclusion of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the ''Sa Nalaor'' crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]], leaving Gamoc and the rest of the crew stranded on the world. The survivors established [[the Retreat]], a base from which they took shelter from Cholganna's deadly wildlife, and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Gamoc was one of only thirty crew-members left alive.
